description_en: Retrieves image URLs based on a list of image IDs
description_zh: ，根据图片ID列表，获取图片地址
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-device-picture-by-list --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id 1CJ00000e7qiq8VkQi1000000 --thumb-width 100 --expire-time 60 --picture-type 2 --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y000000 --picture-id-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDevicePictureByList

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.

You can view the ProductKey on the Products page of the IoT Platform console or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPC device.

You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page of the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPC device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html on IoT Platform to query the ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier of the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The width of the target thumbnail. Unit: px. Valid values: 1 to 4096
parameters.help_zh: 指定目标缩放图的宽度，单位为px，取值范围为1~4096
parameters.name: thumb_width

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the image URL. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 图片URL的失效时间，单位为分钟
parameters.name: expire_time

parameters.help_en:
The image type. Valid values:

0: thumbnail.
1: original image. 
2 (default): all
parameters.help_zh:
图片类型：

0：缩略图。
1：原图。 
2（默认）：全部
parameters.name: picture_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page of the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>

<props="intl">无需传入此参数。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of image IDs. Image IDs are generated when you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107914.html.

A maximum of 50 image IDs can be specified in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
图片ID列表。图片ID由调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107914.html时生成。

单次调用最多支持输入50个图片ID
parameters.name: picture_id_list
